heroSection.title: E|C Engineering College
heroSection.description: Join us at E|C, where innovation meets inspiration. Dive into cutting-edge engineering programs and be part of a future-focused community dedicated to excellence and sustainability.

aboutSection.title: About Us
aboutSection.description: E|C Engineering College is an institution dedicated to advancing knowledge and innovation in the fields of engineering and technology. Located in the heart of a vibrant urban center, E|C offers a dynamic learning environment that combines modern facilities, research, and a commitment to sustainability and environmental stewardship.

quoteSection.quote: Knowledge without application remains incomplete. The mission of E|C is to guide students from understanding to execution, from theory to production, and from education to tangible outcomes that strengthen our regional economy.

programs.name: Software Engineering
programs.description: Our Software Engineering program equips students with the skills needed to design, develop, and maintain software systems. From front-end development to back-end infrastructure, students learn the latest technologies and best practices.

programs.name: Cybersecurity
programs.description: In the Cybersecurity program, students learn to protect digital assets from cyber threats. With hands-on training in ethical hacking, network security, and cryptography, graduates are prepared for careers in information security.

programs.name: Management in IT
programs.description: The Management in IT program prepares students to lead technology-driven projects and organizations. Combining business strategy with information technology, students gain the skills needed to manage teams, systems, and digital transformation.

programs.name: Industrial Design
programs.description: The Industrial Design program prepares students to design functional, user-centered, and visually compelling products. Students combine creativity, engineering thinking, and modern design tools to develop innovative solutions for real-world problems.

cta.title: Ready to Apply?
cta.description: Take the next step towards your future at E|C College of Engineering. Contact us today to learn more about our programs and admissions.

data.title: Hybrid Education with Global Opportunities
data.description: E|C College of Engineering offers a hybrid education model that combines in-person learning with digital tools and flexible formats. Alongside academic programs, students receive preparation for IELTS, TOEFL, SAT, and guidance for studying abroad.

data.title: Learning Through Practice
data.description: Our students do not simply memorize information — they learn through practice. Education is built around real projects, applied tasks, and problem-solving under the guidance of experienced and highly engaged instructors.

data.title: Focused, Career-Oriented Programs
data.description: We offer focused programs designed around the most in-demand skills in the global job market. Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, Management in IT, and Industrial Design prepare students for immediate employment and long-term career growth.

data.title: Outstanding Faculty
data.description: Our greatest strength is our faculty. Most instructors hold PhD degrees and combine strong academic backgrounds with real industry and research experience, actively mentoring and guiding students throughout their studies.

data.title: Strong Industry Connections
data.description: E|C maintains close collaboration with local and international companies, enabling students to participate in internships, industry projects, competitions, and professional networking opportunities.

data.title: Supportive Student-Centered Environment
data.description: Inclusiveness, support, and respect are at the core of our values. We provide a safe and welcoming environment where students receive academic guidance, mentoring, and personal support.

data.title: Active Student Life
data.description: Students actively engage in extracurricular and competitive activities such as Enactus, ICPC, hackathons, innovation challenges, research projects, and community initiatives, building leadership and teamwork skills.

questions.question: What is the duration of the program if starting after grade 9?
questions.answer: The standard duration of study is 2 years and 10 months.

questions.question: What is the duration of the program if starting after grade 11?
questions.answer: The standard duration of study is 1 year and 10 months (with knowledge of English). The standard duration of study is 2 years and 10 months (without knowledge of English).

questions.question: What subjects are included in the entrance exams?
questions.answer: Entrance exams in mathematics, English, and an essay (in Kyrgyz/Russian).

questions.question: What language is used for instruction at the college?
questions.answer: The language of instruction is English. The first year of the program will be conducted in Russian. The second and third years will be conducted in English.

questions.question: What is the cost of the tuition fee?
questions.answer: The tuition cost is $4000, with an initial payment of 30% required. For more detailed information about the tuition fee, please reach out to the admissions office. Contact us at: 0501 990 550.

questions.question: What is covered by the tuition fee?
questions.answer: Along with tuition, each student receives a new corporate access subscription to internal educational platforms, a corporate license for Coursera.org (starting from the second year), licenses for other products, and a personal laptop.

questions.question: Does the tuition fee include meals and accommodation?
questions.answer: No, the college does not provide accommodation or meals.

questions.question: Will the tuition fee change during the study?
questions.answer: The tuition fee that you agreed upon at enrollment will remain unchanged throughout the entire standard duration of study.

questions.question: Can I work with a diploma received after successfully completing the program?
questions.answer: Upon successful completion, graduates receive a diploma of secondary vocational education. You can work in your chosen field with the diploma or continue your studies at a university from the second year.

questions.question: Can graduates find job opportunities abroad?
questions.answer: Yes, after graduation, you can seek employment in Germany and Japan, as long as you have at least a B1 level in German or Japanese and maintain an academic performance of over 85 out of 100.

questions.question: What diploma is awarded upon graduation?
questions.answer: After graduation, a diploma of secondary vocational education is awarded.

questions.question: I don’t have a strong knowledge of English, can I study at your college?
questions.answer: Upon admission, each student takes an English exam. Based on the results, we determine the level of language proficiency and place students into appropriate groups. In addition to the 10th-11th grade subjects, there will be an intensified study of English.

questions.question: What is the study schedule?
questions.answer: The classes are held from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Monday - Friday)

about.title: Light Academy
about.description: Light Academy (L.A.) is an educational brand that began its journey in 2018 and currently operates five international schools across different regions of Kyrgyzstan. This year, Light Academy is opening a new engineering college in Bishkek — E|C Engineering College.
about.overviewDescription:
E|C Engineering College is a modern institution focused on educating future engineers, designers, and technology leaders. Located in the heart of a vibrant urban environment, the college provides a learning space where innovation, creativity, and practical knowledge come together. We combine strong academic foundations with hands-on experience, modern facilities, and digital learning tools to help students turn ideas into real solutions.

At E|C, education goes beyond classrooms. Students learn by doing—through projects, research, collaboration, and engagement with real-world challenges. Our programs are designed to adapt to the rapidly changing world of technology while remaining grounded in ethical responsibility and sustainable development.
about.missionDescription: Our mission is to educate, support, and inspire the next generation of engineers and technologists. We aim to equip students with the technical skills, critical thinking abilities, and creative mindset needed to solve complex industry challenges. Through practical learning, strong mentorship, and a values-driven approach, we prepare students to build solutions that are innovative, responsible, and meaningful for society.
about.visionDescription:
At E|C Engineering College, we envision a future where our graduates play an active role in shaping technological progress around the world. We strive to become a globally recognized institution known for excellence in engineering education, applied research, and industry collaboration.

Our vision is to create an open and inclusive academic community where creativity is encouraged, diversity is valued, and collaboration drives innovation. By fostering curiosity, leadership, and a commitment to sustainability, we aim to prepare students not only for successful careers, but also for lifelong learning and positive impact in an ever-evolving global society.

softwareEngineering.name: Software Engineering
description: The Software Engineering Program is dedicated to advancing the discipline of software development through comprehensive educational programs, research, and collaboration with industry. Focused on the application of engineering principles to the design, development, and implementation of software, the program offers both theoretical and practical training. Students learn about various software development methodologies, project management, and effective team collaboration, preparing them to tackle complex software challenges in a dynamic technological landscape.

cyberSecurity.name: Cyber Security
description: The Cybersecurity Program provides rigorous training and research opportunities in the field of information security. Addressing the increasing threats in the digital world, the program's curriculum covers areas such as network security, ethical hacking, cryptography, and data protection. Through hands-on labs and real-world projects, students are equipped with the skills needed to design, implement, and manage secure systems and to anticipate and mitigate potential security breaches, thus preparing them for high-demand roles in both public and private sectors.

industrialDesign.name: Industrial Design
description: The Industrial Design Program focuses on the creation and development of products that balance functionality, aesthetics, and user experience. The curriculum integrates design thinking, materials science, ergonomics, prototyping, and digital modeling to guide students through the complete product development process—from concept to production.

Students gain both theoretical knowledge and hands-on experience through studio work, real-world projects, and collaboration across engineering and technology disciplines. Emphasis is placed on sustainability, usability, and innovation, preparing graduates to design products that meet modern industry and societal needs.

managementInIT.name: Management in IT
description: The Management in IT Program bridges the gap between technology and business leadership. It focuses on preparing students to manage IT resources, oversee technology projects, and support organizational decision-making in a digital environment.

The curriculum covers key areas such as IT project management, information systems, business analytics, digital strategy, and organizational leadership. Through case studies, team-based projects, and practical applications, students develop both technical awareness and managerial competence.

academics.reasonsTitle: 7 Reasons to Study at E|C College of Engineering

reasons.description: E|C College of Engineering offers a hybrid education model, combining in-person learning with digital resources and flexible formats. In addition to core academic programs, we provide preparation courses for IELTS, TOEFL, SAT, and other language-based exams, as well as guidance and support for students planning to study abroad.

Our students do not simply memorize material—they understand it through practice. Learning is built around real projects, problem-solving, and applied tasks guided by experienced and highly engaged instructors. Our teaching approach ensures that theory is always connected to real-world application.

description.text: E|C College of Engineering offers focused programs designed around the most in-demand skills in the global job market. Each program emphasizes depth, specialization, and practical relevance, preparing students for immediate career entry or further academic growth. Our programs include:
list: Software Engineering: Front-end, Back-end, Full-stack, Mobile Application Development
Management in IT: IT Project Management, Business Analytics, Digital Strategy, Technology Leadership
Industrial Design: Product Design, CAD & Prototyping, User Experience, Sustainable Design

reasons.keywords: Outstanding Faculty as Our Core Strength
reasons.description: The main value of E|C College of Engineering is its faculty. Most of our instructors hold PhD degrees in their respective fields and combine strong academic backgrounds with real industry and research experience. Students learn directly from experts who actively mentor, guide, and inspire them.

Our college maintains close collaboration with local and international companies, enabling students to participate in internships, industry-driven projects, competitions, and professional networking opportunities that support career development.

Inclusiveness, support, and respect are at the core of our values. E|C College of Engineering provides a safe and welcoming environment where students receive academic guidance, mentoring, and personal support, allowing them to grow with confidence both academically and personally.

reasons.keywords: Active Student Life and Community Engagement
reasons.description: Students actively participate in extracurricular and competitive activities such as Enactus, ICPC, hackathons, innovation challenges, research projects, and community initiatives. These experiences strengthen leadership, teamwork, and professional skills beyond the classroom.

cost.description: Initial fee: $1200. Detailed information about tuition fees is available at the admissions office.

documents.title: Required Documents
list: Original state-issued certificate of completion of Grade 9 or 11.
Copy of military registration certificate or military ID (for males over 18).

graduationDocuments.title: Graduation Documents
list: Diploma of secondary vocational education: The main document confirming the receipt of secondary vocational education in a specific specialty. It can be with honors (red diploma) or without honors (blue diploma), depending on the student's performance.
Diploma supplement: This document lists all the subjects the student studied and the grades received. The supplement is an integral part of the diploma.

Certificates: Depending on the training program and additional courses, the student may receive various certificates. These may include certificates for completing advanced training courses or certificates of specific professional skills.
